Admonitions and Quotations

Each admonition label opens one paragraph:

Note

A note gives extra information.

Tip

A tip gives advice.

Warning

A warning describes something that can go wrong.

Important

An important point is easy to miss.

Caution

A caution asks the reader to take care.

The label must match exactly.

NOTES: this line is prose.

This line only mentions NOTE: in passing.

Admonitions can contain inline content:

Tip

Run make test before you push. Read the CI logs when it fails.

A quotation line starts with > followed by a space:

The first quoted line. The second quoted line.

A bare > separates paragraphs inside a quotation:

First, the claim.

Then, the qualification.
